title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study C)
description: Study C of the bigP3BCI collection, which provides EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants using a 6x6 checkerboard P300 speller paradigm with error-related negativity (ERN) components. Data were recorded from 32 channels at 256 Hz with a g.USBamp amplifier, with target and non-target flash events annotated using HED. The dataset is a MOABB-derived BIDS version of the larger PhysioNet bigP3BCI resource, which aims to be an open, diverse and machine-learning-ready P300 BCI dataset.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 channels (standard 10-20 montage) using a g.USBamp (g.tec) at 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a P300 speller task on a 6x6 checkerboard grid with online feedback in a laboratory setting, using a calibration-then-test design. Epochs span 0-1.0 s after stimulus, labeled Target or NonTarget.
